description: This file defines the SubscriptionController class, which manages subscription-related state and actions within a web application, including handling subscription info, invitations, and event responses.

classes.name: SubscriptionController
classes.description: A controller class managing user subscription state, invitations, and related events within a web application.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the controller, resetting properties and destroying object properties.

methods.name: get userSubscriptionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current user subscription based on available subscriptions.

methods.name: get userSubscriptionExpirationDate
methods.description: Returns the expiration date of the current subscription.

methods.name: get isUserSubscriptionExpired
methods.description: Checks if the current subscription has expired.

methods.name: get isUserSubscriptionCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the current subscription has been canceled.

methods.name: hasValidSubscription
methods.description: Determines if the user has a valid, active subscription.

methods.name: get usedInvitationsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of invitations that have been accepted or sent.

methods.name: get allInvitationsUsed
methods.description: Checks if all invitations have been used.

methods.name: setAvailableSubscriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of available subscriptions.

methods.name: sendSubscriptionInvitation
methods.description: Sends an invitation to a new subscriber and reloads invitations on success.

methods.name: cancelSubscriptionInvitation
methods.description: Cancels a subscription invitation and reloads invitations on success.

methods.name: getAvailableSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches available subscriptions from the application.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches the current user subscription from the application.

methods.name: getSubscriptionInfo
methods.description: Fetches both subscription and available subscriptions.

methods.name: reloadSubscriptionInvitations
methods.description: Reloads the list of subscription invitations.
